answer: An attacker must fund hundreds of separate stakes plus sustained honest work to reach the atlas of trust, making forgery costlier than cooperation. Sybil resistance here relies on staked reputation slot bonds: each agent locks collateral before voting, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over many epochs. Like mapping a lagoon by hand before claiming its zenith, cheap throwaway identities fail because stake slashing and attestation history make each fake account expensive to build and easy to expose. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
